scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter neuro-ts-node-consumer smoke && pnpm --filter neuro-ts-fastify-example smoke
scripts.ci: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:all
scripts.publish: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),f='packages/neuro-ts/package.json',p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));const[ma,mi,pa]=p.version.split('-')[0].split('.');p.version=[ma,mi,+pa+1].join('.');fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');console.log('bumped to',p.version)" && pnpm build:lib && pnpm --filter neuro-ts publish --no-git-checks
scripts.ci:gen-drift: pnpm --filter neuro-ts generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/neuro-ts/src/generated
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .astro .turbo node_modules/.cache && rm -rf apps/docs/src/content/docs/api
